source: https://app.runwayml.com (guest workspace: Home /ai-tools/generate, Brand Kits /ai-tools/brand, Apps › Product Shot Video Builder), captured 2026-10-28 at 1440x900 in light and dark schemes

taste.name: Ask first, pick a model later
taste.trigger: When a creator lands on the workspace with something to make
taste.decision: One 840x189 prompt card under a 36px weight-400 question, Reference/Sketch slots inside it and model chips below it, over a tool grid or a model picker as the first thing on screen
taste.reason: The agent routes intent to the model; choosing Seedance vs. GPT Image before stating intent front-loads a decision the user can't make well
evidence: prompt card radius 24px, the only 24px radius on the page
model chips 38px tall below the card
Product Shot Video Builder: upload a product image and 'we'll extract a tailored brief for you'

taste.name: Cool gray chrome, one electric color
taste.trigger: When the page is full of colorful generated media
taste.decision: All chrome from one blue-leaning gray ramp with a single saturated #2C22FA for the one primary action, over multiple accents or tinted panels
taste.reason: The frame must recede behind thumbnails; a cool cast keeps it from reading as plain gray and one electric color makes the next step unmistakable
evidence: links use the lighter #7497FC for readability on black

taste.name: Depth from tinted levels, not borders
taste.trigger: When a dark UI needs sidebar, panels and menus to read as separate planes
taste.decision: Named levels #000 -> #131416 -> #1B1E23 and a 6.7% periwinkle-tinted sidebar instead of divider lines or stacked shadows
taste.reason: Lines multiply fast in a tool UI; luminance steps keep the screen quiet while a 5% hairline on cards carries the edge
evidence: only floating menus carry a drop shadow in dark mode

taste.name: Light headline, dense controls
taste.trigger: When a tool page has one headline and many small controls
taste.decision: 36px weight-400 headline with -1% tracking; everything else 14px at 400-600 on an 8/6px rhythm, over a bold display headline or roomy 16px controls
taste.reason: The weight belongs to the media; dense 14px controls fit slots, chips and tabs in one row
